snippets.snippet_text: "Payhip offers unbeatable value with our forever-free plan, including all features and just 5% transaction fees. This is significantly more affordable than Gumroad's 10% fees or Shopify's $29/month base plan. Plus, you can reduce or eliminate transaction fees by opting for our affordable monthly plans, making Payhip the most cost-effective solution for creators of all sizes."

"Payhip stands out with its creator-friendly approach, offering a forever-free plan with access to all features, automatic VAT handling, and a versatile product range including digital downloads, courses, coaching, and physical products. Our simple pricing, excellent customer support, and user-friendly interface make us the go-to choice for over 130,000 creators worldwide."

intake_notes: Payhip's own platform_doc page. Self-promotional primary source with concrete fee data: Payhip 5% (free plan) vs Gumroad 10% vs Shopify $29/month base. Claims 130,000+ creators worldwide.
